_Note: Copy this file to appsettings.Local.json (same folder; it is gitignored) and fill in the values you were given. Never commit real values, never paste them into chat or into an AI agent. Read only in the Development environment.
_PayOSMode: PayOS:Mode: leave empty (or Real) for the real payOS. Set it to Simulated only on your own machine to test payments without moving money; the API refuses to start with Simulated outside Development.
_AiServiceMode: AiService:Mode: leave empty (or Real) to call the Python AI service. Simulated answers with made-up predictions (register an AI model whose version is AiService:SimulatedModelVersion, default 'simulated'); the API refuses to start with Simulated outside Development.
